verses.1: And Elohim gathered together his people and said:
verses.2: He has removed my sins and my transgressions from me.
verses.3: For now, I am still alive within me, and the spirit of God is in my heart.
verses.4: If you speak my words, they will be heard and understood. But if I speak in a different manner, then my words will remain unheard.
verses.5: May I not be justified before you, until I am released from this situation.
verses.6: In my righteousness, I will strengthen myself; I will not allow anyone to break my heart from the days of old.
verses.7: May my enemies be like a mountain that I must climb.
verses.8: For what kind of sin is it to be naked, when one commits such an act? When someone has a god in their heart.
verses.9: His cry will be heard by God, when sorrow approaches upon him.
verses.10: If the shepherd is sad, God will call out to him at all times.
verses.11: I will deal with you in the hand of El, who is with Shadai and does not forget.
verses.12: You all are witnesses. Why then should there be darkness among you?
verses.13: This is the punishment for a wicked person, who will be taken away from his home and suffer the fate of oppressors.
verses.14: If their children become like thorns, and their descendants cannot be satisfied with anything.
verses.15: Their remains will be buried in the ground, and their bodies will not be mourned.
verses.16: If gold and copper are kept in their proper places, then they can be used to make tools.
verses.17: The righteous will be blessed, and they will receive pure silver.
verses.18: He built his house and also made a synagogue for worship.
verses.19: A rich man lies down, but his eyes remain closed; he doesn’t open them.
verses.20: They will find him in the water, at night. He has been stolen away.
verses.21: It will be carried away from its place, and it will be taken away from there.
verses.22: And it will be thrown upon him, and he will not be harmed by its breath; it will flee away.
verses.23: It will shake him from his place, and it will toss him around from where he is.
